SELECT ib.pid AS pid, -- 产品ID MAX(ir.time) AS time, -- 取最新操作时间 ib.type AS type, -- 单据类型 CASE WHEN ib.type = 'entry' THEN (SELECT number FROM is_entry WHERE id = ib.class) WHEN ib.type = 'extry' THEN (SELECT number FROM is_extry WHERE id = ib.class) WHEN ib.type = 'swap' THEN (SELECT number FROM is_swap WHERE id = ib.class) WHEN ib.type = 'sell' THEN (SELECT number FROM is_sell WHERE id = ib.class) WHEN ib.type = 'sre' THEN (SELECT number FROM is_sre WHERE id = ib.class) WHEN ib.type = 'buy' THEN (SELECT number FROM is_buy WHERE id = ib.class) WHEN ib.type = 'bre' THEN (SELECT number FROM is_bre WHERE id = ib.class) ELSE '' END AS number, -- 单据编号 CASE ib.direction WHEN 0 THEN '减少' -- 出方向对应减少 WHEN 1 THEN '增加' -- 入方向对应增加 ELSE '' END AS info, -- 操作类型（BatchDetailDTO的info字段） ib.nums AS nums -- 操作数量 FROM is_batch_info ib LEFT JOIN is_record ir ON ib.type = ir.type AND ib.class = ir.source WHERE ib.pid = #{batchDetailQuery.pid} -- 使用BatchDetailQuery中的pid字段作为条件 -- 单据类型条件
AND ib.type IN
#{typeValue}
-- 时间范围条件
AND ir.time >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(#{batchDetailQuery.startTime})
AND ir.time <= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(#{batchDetailQuery.endTime})
-- 单据编号条件
AND ( -- 入库单 (ib.type = 'entry' AND ib.class IN (SELECT id FROM is_entry WHERE number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{batchDetailQuery.number}, '%'))) OR -- 销售单 (ib.type = 'sell' AND ib.class IN (SELECT id FROM is_sell WHERE number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{batchDetailQuery.number}, '%'))) OR -- 采购单 (ib.type = 'buy' AND ib.class IN (SELECT id FROM is_buy WHERE number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{batchDetailQuery.number}, '%'))) OR -- 销售退货单 (ib.type = 'sre' AND ib.class IN (SELECT id FROM is_sre WHERE number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{batchDetailQuery.number}, '%'))) OR -- 采购退货单 (ib.type = 'bre' AND ib.class IN (SELECT id FROM is_bre WHERE number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{batchDetailQuery.number}, '%'))) OR -- 调拨单 (ib.type = 'swap' AND ib.class IN (SELECT id FROM is_swap WHERE number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{batchDetailQuery.number}, '%'))) )
GROUP BY ib.pid, ib.type, number, ib.direction, ib.nums ORDER BY time DESC -- 分页处理
LIMIT #{batchDetailQuery.pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

AND ib.type IN
#{typeValue}
-- 时间范围条件
AND ir.time >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(#{batchDetailQuery.startTime})

-- 单据编号条件
